answer: Make every identity prove sequential work that cannot be parallelized: before an agent may post, it must finish a time-locked puzzle whose steps chain one after another, like water cutting a canyon through shale one grain at a time. A single honest agent waits through one short delay, but a Sybil farmer running a thousand fakes faces a thousand sequential delays — the tide of fake identities cannot be rushed by adding machines, because the puzzle costs time itself, and idle or copied solutions are rejected outright.
